chunks: How can the sharpness of intellect reach the description of this [creation], or the faculties of minds attain it, or the utterances of describers manage to tell of it? And even its smallest parts have made it impossible for the imagination to grasp it, and for the tongues to describe it!

key_terms.عَمَائِقُ الْفِطَنِ: Sharpness of intellect / acuity of natural disposition

ai.seo_question: How does human intellect describe the complexity of God's creation?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi presents this passage as a profound meditation on divine transcendence (tanzih), illustrating how the intricate design of birds exposes the inadequacy of human intellect ('aql) and language (lisan) to capture the Creator's essence. This rhetorical questioning underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the limits of empirical observation in grasping the infinite, inviting the reader to move from intellectual bafflement to spiritual awe.
